verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform that ships AI features (Seer, Autofix), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Server-side data scrubbing and the self-hosted deployment option are adjacent privacy controls, not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit.
